source.title: WoW Price Hub Khaz'gorite Ore quality-rank identity and independent original-processing search

notes: No NEW measured Dragonflight prospect/mill/DE source with independently verified completed casts, material castsWithDrop, 0-N histograms or refund-aware denominators was found. NEW secondary-source cross-provider identity corroboration (not a processing study): WoW Price Hub labels Khaz'gorite Ore item 190313 crafting TIER_2 and 190314 TIER_3, agreeing with GoldCap's 190313 rank 2 and 190314 rank 3. GoldCap independently labels 190312 rank 1; the WoW Price Hub 190312 response displayed an older layout without an explicit tier, so do not claim independent validation of rank 1 from that page. Full GoldCap map: 190312=rank 1, 190313=rank 2, 190314=rank 3. This corroborates previously recorded ranks but is not a first-party Blizzard tooltip/API, and no source links ore rank to an original per-cast study. Previously collected Serevite/Draconium quality maps and Mystic-item DE comments remain deduplicated. Never convert any reported ore/item totals or secondary market metadata into measured P(hit), casts, zero counts, material yields or confidence.
lookingFor: Fresh original completed-operation prospecting Khaz'gorite, Draconium, Serevite and Prismatic Ore by exact ranked input/output ID; Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling 0-N per-cast output histograms; independent Khaz'gorite rank-to-item identity check
whereLooked: Reddit r/woweconomy original Draconium Ore prospecting batch logs, completed casts, item-rank output and refund-aware material tables; only already indexed Bugy/Xenastro/10i63zb studies surfaced.

Reddit r/woweconomy original Khaz'gorite Ore prospecting outcome logs; existing 100 R2 ore/20 prospects/no diamond January 2023 report was already indexed (https://www.reddit.com/r/woweconomy/comments/10h6ccx).
Reddit r/woweconomy original Serevite Ore results by item rank, after December 2022; known ar_rules original and 10b8z7x previously recorded, not recopied.

Wowhead Dragon Isles Prospecting spell and Draconium Ore comments: existing Bugy pooled-average table, without output-specific per-completed-cast hit/zero histogram (https://www.wowhead.com/spell=374627/dragon-isles-prospecting).
Wowhead Prismatic Ore/Illimited Diamond comments and original result tables: known original Prismatic cohorts and no new verified 0-N output study.

Wowhead Saxifrage item 191464 and 191466 and related Blazing Pigment pages: qualitative source facts; no original newly quantified completed-mill 0-N histogram (https://www.wowhead.com/item=191466/saxifrage).
Reddit r/woweconomy and Blizzard US forums named Bubble Poppy and Saxifrage milling 1000/2000 inputs pigment logs: no additional independent completed-cast material table.
wow-professions.com Dragon Isles Inscription and Jewelcrafting guides: recipe and quality background only; no independent original casts/hits/refunds ledger.
Warcraft Wiki Draconium Ore/Dragon Isles Prospecting and milling references: names and mechanics, not new quantitative studies (https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Draconium_Ore).

GitHub t-mart/wow-auction README: original software author explicitly maps Serevite 190395=R1,190396=R2,190394=R3, already recorded in prior research, not a new measurement (https://github.com/t-mart/wow-auction/blob/master/README.md).
GoldCap US Retail Khaz'gorite ranked item pages: 190312=rank 1, 190313=rank 2, 190314=rank 3, corroboration of existing secondary identity lead (https://goldcap.gg/retail/us/items/190312).

WoW Price Hub live item pages: newly located independent Khaz'gorite TIER_2 item 190313 and TIER_3 item 190314, agreeing with GoldCap; item 190312 served an older layout that did not expose its tier, so no second-provider R1 claim (https://wowpricehub.com/us/illidan/item/Khaz%27gorite%20Ore-190313 ; https://wowpricehub.com/us/illidan/item/Khaz%27gorite%20Ore-190314).

Wago ProspectMate addon (updated June 17 2026) documents per-character Dragonflight tracking and resetting historical profession samples, but does not publish an original shared Dragonflight completed-cast export (https://addons.wago.io/addons/prospectmate).

Wowhead named Anguished Restraints 207120/Elder's Volcanic Wrap 207118/Lifewoven Slippers 207123: accessible pages did not expose actual Disenchanting Looter numerator/denominator; no fabricated occurrences.
Wowhead live Mystic item commenter observations: 200941, 200942, 200943, 200945 amounts are already independently recorded in dragonflight-20261031-173015..019; not duplicated.
